method: Actual rendered AR/EN six states at390; rest, all available hover controls, and modal. Visible direct text4.5:1; original icon strokes3:1. Solid semantic surfaces resolved through ancestor backgrounds. Explicit control boundaries, selected-navigation underline and focus surfaces3:1. This is sampled contrast evidence, not WCAG certification.
exclusions: Decorative gold date repeat, card/divider rules, inner arrow-frame separator and static loading skeleton carry no sole information or control-boundary meaning. Text labels, icon strokes, action fills and focus/selection are tested.
